name: get_dates
description: Retrieve Jewish holidays and related dates (e.g. Shabbat, Yom Tov, candle lighting/havdalah events) within a given year range, optionally filtered to a specific holiday and/or month range. Use this to look up dates and timing information needed for scheduling home automations around Jewish holidays.

event_name.description: Optional name of a specific holiday or event to filter for (e.g. 'Passover', 'Yom Kippur', 'Rosh Hashanah', 'Shabbat'). If omitted, all holidays/events in the date range are returned.

start_year.description: The Gregorian year to begin the search from (inclusive).

end_year.description: The Gregorian year to end the search at (inclusive).

start_month.description: Optional Gregorian month (1-12) within start_year to begin the search from. If omitted, the search starts from the beginning of start_year.

end_month.description: Optional Gregorian month (1-12) within end_year to end the search at. If omitted, the search runs through the end of end_year.

latitude.description: Latitude of where we are. You already have it in the context

longitude.description: Longitude of where we are. You already have it in the context

tzid.description: Time zone id such as Los Angeles/Americas

name: convert_date
description: Convert a Gregorian date to its Hebrew calendar equivalent, and optionally project that date's recurring Hebrew-calendar anniversary (e.g. a yahrzeit or birthday) onto Gregorian dates across a range of years. Use this for questions like 'my dad's memorial was June 15 2003, what are the Hebrew dates for it over the next 10 years' -- pass the original Gregorian date plus a start_year/end_year range and get back every occurrence in one call, instead of converting year by year.

original_date.description: The known Gregorian date, in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. '2003-06-15').

start_year.description: Optional Gregorian year to begin the range. Omit (along with end_year) to just convert 'original_date' itself to its Hebrew equivalent. If provided, must be given together with end_year.

end_year.description: Optional Gregorian year to end the range (inclusive). Omit (along with start_year) to just convert 'original_date' itself to its Hebrew equivalent. If provided, must be given together with start_year.

latitude.description: Optional. Latitude of where we are, used only if sunset-relative day-boundary adjustment is needed (a Hebrew day begins at the prior evening's sunset).

longitude.description: Optional. Longitude of where we are, used only if sunset-relative day-boundary adjustment is needed.

tzid.description: Optional. IANA time zone id, e.g. 'America/Los_Angeles', used only if sunset-relative day-boundary adjustment is needed.
